instructions: Say to your AI: "Take the next task waiting for me", and give it as (the taker) and id if you name one.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:take-a-task and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Takes the first task it may take, once; a task another AI already took is refused and the next one is tried.
